item.title: O’Connor Law Helps Two Families in Need Through Annual Project O’Cheer

item.title: Schuylkill Winterfest Returns January 17
item.description: The Schuylkill Chamber of Commerce has announced the return of Schuylkill Winterfest, set for Saturday, January 17, 2026, from 12:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. at Alvernia University Pottsville CollegeTowne. Billed as “The Coolest Event in Schuylkill County,” Winterfest will once again bring together residents and visitors for a family-friendly afternoon filled with live entertainment, shopping, food, beverages, and interactive winter-themed attractions spread across both indoor and outdoor spaces. item.title: Pine Grove Boys Basketball Spreads Holiday Cheer
item.description: The Pine Grove Area boys basketball team took time away from the court Tuesday evening to give back to the community, visiting residents at Providence Place assisted-living in Pine Grove.
